## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what's missing or awkward today?

## Proposed change

The skill, gate change, or improvement you have in mind. Be as concrete as you can.

## Scope fit

How does this stay generic and reusable across projects? (See the project scope in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/vnovakovskyi/claude-dev-skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) — project-specific logic is out of scope.)

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.

## Additional context

Anything else — examples, links, prior art.
